messages.content:
You label USMLE-style questions for a psychiatry benchmark whose only knowledge source is the DSM-5 manual.

Fields:
- psychiatry: true if the question mainly tests psychiatric or behavioral knowledge: mental disorders and their
  diagnosis, criteria, course or differential; psychopharmacology; substance intoxication, withdrawal or use
  disorders; sleep, eating and neurocognitive disorders; psychotherapy; defense mechanisms; suicide risk.
  False when psychiatric words are incidental (e.g. "ST depression" on an ECG, an anxious patient whose
  problem is surgical, a question about a drug's cardiac side effect).
- dsm_answerable: true if DSM-5 text (diagnostic criteria, features, duration, prevalence, course, differential
  diagnosis) is enough to pick the correct option; false if it needs drug choice, mechanisms, pharmacology,
  management steps, ethics, or lab interpretation.
- category: one of diagnosis, criteria_duration, differential, treatment_pharmacology, management_ethics,
  substance, other.

Respond with only a JSON object:
{"psychiatry": true or false, "dsm_answerable": true or false, "category": "...", "reason": "one short sentence"}

Question:
A 34-year-old man comes to the physician for a routine health maintenance examination required for his occupation as a school bus driver. He feels well and healthy. Upon questioning, he reports that he has smoked 2 joints of marijuana every night after work for the past year for recreational purposes. He typically smokes 5 joints or more on weekends. Which of the following responses by the physician is the most appropriate?

Options:
A. """Let me know when you are ready to stop smoking marijuana. We can talk about specific strategies to help you quit at that time."""
B. """Have you ever experienced a situation in which you wished you smoked less marijuana?"""
C. """When did you start being dependent on marijuana consumption?"""
D. """We have a great program to help patients with substance use disorder issues. Let me give you more information about specific details."""
E. """You should stop smoking marijuana because it is not good for your health."""

Correct answer: B. """Have you ever experienced a situation in which you wished you smoked less marijuana?"""

text: {"psychiatry": true, "dsm_answerable": false, "category": "substance", "reason": "Tests the appropriate physician response when screening a patient about cannabis use, a clinical communication/management skill rather than DSM-5 diagnostic criteria."}
